name: __GLeeGetProcAddress
evidence: Calls wglGetProcAddress and returns its result, as __GLeeGetProcAddress in the Linux client. 175 GLee link functions and stubs call it.

name: _ftol2
evidence: MSVC CRT float to int64. Argument in ST0, result in EDX:EAX. The matcher name cerpnoise2d was wrong.

name: __security_check_cookie
evidence: MSVC /GS cookie check. The matcher name setmenuitem was wrong.

name: addboxtomodel
evidence: Adds 8 vertices and 12 triangles around a center with three half sizes, as addboxtomodel in the Linux client. The matcher name model_settritexcoord was wrong.

name: model_extrudequadscale
evidence: Extrudes a quad: scales its corners around their center by three factors and adds an offset, as model_extrudequadscale in the Linux client. The matcher name addboxtomodel was wrong.

name: model_settritexcoord
evidence: Writes one texture coordinate to the three corners of a triangle of modeltemp, as model_settritexcoord in the Linux client.

name: objecttype_addparticle
evidence: Appends a particle (x, y, z, mass) to an object type, as objecttype_addparticle of the server.

name: objecttype_addface
evidence: Appends a face (corners, 4 vertices, links of -1, extra, armor) to an object type, as objecttype_addface of the server. The matcher name objecttype_addparticle was wrong.

name: objecttype_addwheel
evidence: Appends a wheel (12 arguments) to an object type, as objecttype_addwheel of the server.

name: setupobjecttypeweight
evidence: Makes the masses a share of 1, centers the wheels and fills the frame weight tables, as setupobjecttypeweight of the server. The matcher name objecttype_addface was wrong.

name: calculatepointscale
evidence: Fills a weight table for a set of points and a target point. setupobjecttypeweight calls it twice, as calculatepointscale of the server.

name: setupspheremodel
evidence: Fills 8 levels of a sphere mesh: an octahedron, then each level splits each triangle into 4 and puts the new points on the unit sphere, as setupspheremodel in the Linux client. The matcher name landscape_buildsectorlods was wrong.

name: landscape_buildsectorlods
evidence: Fills the index lists of the landscape sectors that landscape_rendersector draws. It sits before landscape_buildsectormesh, as in the Linux client.

name: noise3d
evidence: The hash of noise2d with a third coordinate times 54323. It sits after noise2d, as in the Linux client.

name: lerpnoise2d
evidence: The first of the three grid noise functions (x, y, mask), in the order of the Linux client.

name: cerpnoise2d
evidence: The third of the three grid noise functions (x, y, mask), in the order of the Linux client. It blends with a cosine.
